stem: A recirculating system adds water and fertilizer based only on reservoir EC while no records are kept for inflow, drain volume or ion composition. What is the strongest systems concern?
choices: Without mass-balance and composition evidence, stable EC can mask selective ion accumulation or depletion
Stable EC proves the nutrient solution is unchanged
Drain volume is irrelevant in recirculation
Only pH needs to be recorded
rationale: Bulk conductivity does not fully describe nutrient composition. Recirculating management benefits from tracking water and nutrient flows as well as periodic composition evidence.
